verdict_rationale: All 14 preflight checks applicable at this stage received PASS. 4 production-gate checks are not applicable before a model exists — they will be assessed at stages 08 (model dev), 13 (export/MT4 parity), and 14 (forward-test/online). This is consistent with methodology: checks 5/12/16/17/18 inherently require a trained model or online path.

8_pool_isolation.detail: PLL groups use input indices only. Targets not in any pool.

10_input_target_separation.detail: Input PLL normalizer operates on selected indices only; targets not scaled.

11_dominance.detail: 2 flagged pools resolved by splitting groups / no normalization.

14_atr_contract.detail: ATR_ratio = log(fractal_atr / ATR_slow). No further normalization.

production_gate_checks_pending_model.note: These checks are part of the full 18-point leakage checklist but require a trained model, online path, or MT4 integration to assess. They will be re-evaluated at the relevant later stages (08, 13, 14).

16_export_rule_freeze.reason: model and rule not yet selected

naming_convention.rule: fractal-level fields use fractal*. prefix; top-level targets use bare target name
naming_convention.input_updn: fractal*.up_12, fractal*.dn_12, ... — live-safe accumulated state from MQL producer

atr_contract: ATR_ratio = log(fractal_atr / ATR_slow). Fractal_atr from CSV field 21. ATR_slow from row-level ATR column. No further scaling.
